summary: Completed backend (pytest, 6/6 passing) + frontend (Playwright) testing of Datapoolwaters Advisory site. All requested flows verified — contact API (create/validate/list with _id exclusion), health endpoint, all 7 nav routes, pillar tabs, success stories filters, case study detail page, contact form happy path + invalid-email block, footer policy links, article page, mobile nav toggle. No blocking issues.
action_items: No action items. Inform future test agents: footer policy testids are derived from label (e.g. 'Privacy Policy' -> footer-policy-privacy-policy, 'Terms of Service' -> footer-policy-terms-of-service), not route slug. Original review request mentioned filter-ppp which exists and works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: good separation, Pydantic validation, UUID ids, _id excluded on GET via projection — clean.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.93) — not blocking.

Contact POST stores created_at as ISO string but response model serializes ContactSubmission with datetime — OK since it's returned before write. List endpoint converts back via fromisoformat — works but mixed storage format; acceptable for MVP.
No rate-limiting on /api/contact — could be abused once public; consider basic IP throttling post-MVP.
Frontend SuccessStories.jsx uses .dpw-eyebrow (uppercase) for section labels; for screen readers make sure aria-labels also set (minor a11y nit).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this build.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created contact submissions with subject prefix TEST_<uuid> on each run; small data footprint, no cleanup endpoint exposed (acceptable for MVP).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend exposes only /api/health, /api/ (root), POST /api/contact, GET /api/contact. Contact ContactSubmissionCreate validates: name 2-120, email EmailStr, organization <=160 optional, phone <=40 optional, subject 2-160, message 5-5000. Footer policy testid pattern is `footer-policy-{label-lowercased-hyphenated-no-special-chars}`. Case study slugs come from /app/frontend/src/data/caseStudies.js (e.g. arnergy-series-a, agroeknor-growth, nigeria-high-speed-rail). When asserting case-detail section labels via inner_text, note dpw-eyebrow applies uppercase transform — use case-insensitive match. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py is reusable as regression suite.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issues. Two initial Playwright false-negatives were resolved: (1) footer-policy-privacy selector wrong — correct pattern is footer-policy-privacy-policy; (2) case-detail text match failed due to CSS uppercase transform affecting inner_text — resolved by lowercasing.
